summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filed by Okeanis Eco Tankers Corp. on April 24, 2026, announcing its 2026 Annual Meeting of Shareholders scheduled for May 29, 2026. The meeting agenda includes standard proposals: election of eight directors and ratification of Deloitte as independent auditors for the year ending December 31, 2026. No special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or strategic review is indicated. The filing is a regular proxy statement and meeting notice, with no extraordinary corporate action or event. This is a standard foreign private issuer report with no special-situation elements.
